tool.name: Make.lefse
tool.description: create a lefse formatted input file from mothur's output files
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat && ln -s '$design' design.dat && ln -s '$constaxonomy' constaxonomy.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $otu.is_of_type("mothur.relabund"): #silent $mothur_args.append("relabund=otu.dat") #else #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=otu.dat") #end if #if $design: #silent $mothur_args.append("design=design.dat") #end if #if $constaxonomy: #silent $mothur_args.append("constaxonomy=constaxonomy.dat") #end if #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("scale=" + str($scale))
echo 'make.lefse(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.label: shared or relabund - provide a shared or relabund file
label - OTU Labels
param.help: If none selected, the first label in your file will be used

param.label: scale - select what scale you would like to use to convert your shared file abundances to relative abundances

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The make.lefse_ allows you to create a lefse formatted input file from mothur's output files.
.. _make.lefse: https://mothur.org/wiki/make.lefse/
